<script>
(function () {
  function init(root, tries) {
    var el = root.querySelector('.ak-carousel .swiper, .ak-carousel .e-n-carousel');
    if (!el || !el.swiper) {
      if (tries < 75) setTimeout(function () { init(root, tries + 1); }, 200);
      return;
    }
    var sw = el.swiper;
    sw.params.rewind = true;
    var thumbs = [].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.ak-thumb'));
    function perView() { return Math.round(sw.params.slidesPerView) || 1; }
    function last() { return Math.max(0, sw.slides.length - perView()); }
    function update() {
      var a = sw.activeIndex, pv = perView();
      thumbs.forEach(function (t, i) { t.classList.toggle('is-on', i >= a && i < a + pv); });
    }
    function bind(sel, fn) {
      var b = root.querySelector(sel + ' .elementor-button');
      if (b) b.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); fn(); });
    }
    bind('.ak-prev', function () { sw.activeIndex <= 0 ? sw.slideTo(last()) : sw.slidePrev(); });
    bind('.ak-next', function () { sw.activeIndex >= last() ? sw.slideTo(0) : sw.slideNext(); });
    thumbs.forEach(function (t, i) {
      t.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); sw.slideTo(Math.min(i, last())); });
    });
    sw.on('slideChange', update);
    sw.on('breakpoint', update);
    sw.on('resize', update);
    update();
  }
  function start() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.ak-ponentes').forEach(function (r) { init(r, 0); });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  else start();
})();
</script>
